content.text:
I have reviewed all responsive locations. Summary of findings before submitting:

- **7.1.1 (p0427-p0428):** each Party solely owns Information/inventions it makes and its background IP — no assignment of AbbVie IP to Harpoon.
- **7.1.2 (p0429):** joint ownership exists, but with an express unrestricted exploitation right (no consent, no accounting) — outside walk-away territory.
- **3.8.2(c) (p0327):** AbbVie solely owns all Regulatory Documentation/Approvals, with Harpoon further-assurances assignment obligations running **to** AbbVie.
- **5.1.3 / 5.3 / 1.145 / 12.1.2:** worldwide exclusive licence to Exploit with multi-tier sublicensing, becoming fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable on expiry.
- **5.2 / 5.6.2:** Harpoon's licence under AbbVie IP is narrow — solely as necessary to perform its Initial Development Plan obligations; no other grants.
- **12.7.1:** reversion is a licence (not an assignment), conditional and royalty-bearing to AbbVie.

This meets the fallback on its material terms and is not redlined.

input.quote: Subject to the licenses and rights of reference granted under Sections 5.1 and 5.2 and, in the case of Harpoon, its exclusivity obligations hereunder, each Party shall have the right to Exploit the Joint Intellectual Property Rights without a duty of seeking consent from or accounting to the other Party.
input.rationale: The IP allocation sits at (and in ownership direction above) the fallback, so we do not redline it. Section 7.1.1 gives each Party sole ownership of the Information, inventions and IP it creates and of its background IP, and Section 3.8.2(c) makes AbbVie the sole owner of all Regulatory Documentation (including Regulatory Approvals and Product Labeling) for the Licensed Compounds/Products, with Harpoon obliged to execute confirmatory assignments to AbbVie. No AbbVie IP or data is assigned to Harpoon anywhere: Section 5.2 grants Harpoon only a non-exclusive, non-sublicensable licence under AbbVie Patents/Know-How "solely to the extent necessary for Harpoon to perform its obligations as set forth in, and subject to, the Initial Development Plan," and Section 5.6.2 confirms no other AbbVie rights are granted — i.e., Harpoon's licence in our data is confined to service delivery. Harpoon's retention of its own platform know-how (Section 5.6.1) is expressly permitted by the playbook. Joint ownership is created by Section 7.1.2, but it is workable rather than walk-away: each Party may Exploit Joint IP without consent or accounting, and the only overlays (AbbVie's own exclusive licences and Harpoon's exclusivity covenant) run in our favour. On the licence side, Section 5.1.3 gives AbbVie an exclusive licence to Exploit in the Territory (defined at 1.145 as "the entire world"), Section 5.3 permits sublicensing through multiple tiers to Affiliates and other Persons, and Section 12.1.2 provides that on expiration the grants become "non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable." Noted but not flagged: the licence is royalty-bearing and revocable during the Term (the core commercial bargain of an option/licence deal, priced under Article 6), and the preferred "no joint ownership" position is not achieved. The Section 12.7.1 reversion is a conditional, royalty-bearing licence of a defined AbbVie Reversion IP set — not an assignment of our IP. Several sub-clauses of 7.1.2 and 12.7 are redacted ([***]), so those carve-outs could not be verified.
